title: Craftphone
description: A Minecraft mod that adds a modern in-game phone with apps like camera, gallery, chats, calls, browser, CraftGPT, calculator, notes, tasks, timer, and a virtual chest. Supports NeoForge 1.21.1 and Fabric 1.21.1.
body:
# CraftPhone

**CraftPhone** brings a modern smartphone experience to Minecraft!  
With CraftPhone, you get several useful apps directly in-game, including a camera, gallery, chats, calls, CraftGPT, browser, calculator, notes, tasks, timer, and even a virtual chest.

## Features

- 📱 **In-game smartphone** with its own user interface
- 💬 **Chats & messages**
- 📞 **Calls** with optional voice chat support
- 📸 **Camera** and **gallery**
- 🌐 **Browser app**
- 🤖 **CraftGPT** for AI features
- 🧮 **Calculator**
- 📝 **Notes** and **task list**
- ⏱️ **Timer**
- 📦 **Virtual chest** accessible through the phone
- 🌍 Multi-language support, including English, German, French, Spanish, and Arabic
